class.name: JarTerrainMaterial
class.brief_description: One surface material of a [JarVoxelVolume]: grass, rock, sand, painted stone...
class.description: Materials are listed in [member JarVoxelVolume.materials]; a material's index is the id that edits and [method JarVoxelVolume.paint] write, and that the shader's ground rules ([code]ground_material[/code], [code]cliff_material[/code], ...) refer to. The volume packs all its materials into a palette texture and texture arrays for the terrain shader, so the default shaders and your own shaders see the same materials. Without textures a material is shaded procedurally: [member albedo] with large-scale brightness and hue variation and fine detail, controlled by [member variation] and the shader's [code]look[/code] settings.

members.member: Base color (sRGB). With an [member albedo_texture] it tints the texture.
Optional color texture, applied with triplanar mapping. All textures of a volume are converted to the size of the first one and packed into a texture array.
Optional normal map, applied with triplanar mapping.
Meters covered by one tile of the textures.
Strength of the procedural variation (large brightness and warm/cool patches, fine detail). [code]0[/code] gives a flat color.
